Thanks for reaching out. To move forward we still need a couple of details:

- The email or username linked to your order
- Your invoice ID, if you already completed the purchase

Reply here and we will pick it up right away.

macros.contenido: We are on it. Your case is being processed right now and you will get an update in this channel as soon as there is news. Thanks for your patience.

Your order has been delivered. Please check the details and confirm everything works on your side.

If anything looks wrong, tell us in this ticket before closing it and we will sort it out.

macros.descripcion: Explica como se aplica la garantia
macros.contenido: Your purchase is covered by our warranty. Send us the invoice ID and a short description of the issue and we will replace or repair the product at no extra cost.
We have not heard back from you in a while, so we will close this ticket shortly. If you still need help, just reply here and it will stay open.
